title: District 9
synopsis: A bureaucrat enforcing an eviction on a slum of stranded aliens, a black canister, and a transformation that finally costs him his certainty.

nodes.text: A camera crew, a clipboard, a cheerful introduction.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Polite.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your wife finds a metal flower on her windowsill. The reporter at the door cannot prove who left it. She knows.
Three years later a ship descends on Johannesburg and a small alien hand lifts you up off the dirt and a cure begins.
You stand at the gate of District 10 in a kind of dusk that suits you now, and you watch the capsule rise toward a mother ship that will, one day, return.
